title: Police launch criminal investigation into Reform UK donations
description: The investigation, which follows a broadcast by Channel 4 News, is being folded into the inquiry that has been under way into other donations.

title: Air traffic failure was avoidable, says transport secretary
description: Heidi Alexander orders an investigation into the glitch that caused more than 2,000 flight cancellations.

title: National security can't come at expense of social security, Burnham says
description: The prime minister says he will fund defence and get the welfare bill down in "the Labour way".

title: Watch: Europe's royalty pay last respects to King Harald V in Norway
description: Tens of thousands of people lined the streets to pay their respects after 13 days of national mourning.

title: Miliband rejects chief rabbi's claim British Jews in greater danger after sanctions move
description: The foreign secretary disagrees that sanctions on Israeli settlements could put British Jews at greater risk.

title: Tate brothers to remain in US jail as they fight extradition to UK
description: A federal judge denied them bail, saying the dual US-UK citizens' wealth and frequent international travel "constitute quintessential flight risks".

title: RNLI volunteer targeted online and branded 'traitor' after Portsmouth protests
description: Lifeboat crew member wrongly identified as having helped small boat migrants speaks to BBC Verify.

title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
description: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.

title: Hundreds mourn police officer killed in wrong-way A66 crash
description: Officers give PC Matthew Blades a guard of honour as people line the streets for his funeral.
